span.p:
Chat workspace
• Agent catalog, chat, live tool status
• Settings: chapter name, video render, Google Drive
• Browser storage: settings + saved event profile

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Result cards (A2UI)
rendered from the backend ui payload
on the shared ResultCard shell
• Video + scenario deck • Countdown post plan
• Event details • Recognised receipts • QR code
• Agenda • E-mail draft • Dates • Documents

pick folder / template / files
